meta.name: Mattel Jr.: Thomas & Friends, Laugh & Learn
meta.description:
Mattel Jr. is your child’s passport to a world of enchantment, education and endless fun. Dive into the delightful realm of Fisher-Price's beloved characters.

Shows: Thomas & Friends, Laugh & Learn, Kipper, American Girl Dolled Up!, Wellie Wishers
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
